title: There Was a Farmer, Had a Dog
transcription:
There Was a Farmer,
Had a Dog...

There was a farmer, had a dog, I hit it
with my pick-up,
SPLAT, SPLAT, SPLAT,
I hit it with my pick-up.

To the tune of BINGO, with the same
descending and ascending order of verses.
